warning a11y_consider_explicit_label 1:1-1:25 Buttons and links should either contain text or have an `aria-label`, `aria-labelledby` or `title` attribute

warning event_directive_deprecated 1:9-1:15 Using `on:tou` to listen to the tou event is deprecated. Use the event attribute `ontou` instead
